items.title: Local SEO
items.summary: Rank higher for the searches that bring customers through the door.
items.overview: We optimise your website and on-page content, build local citations, and structure your Google Business Profile alongside your site so you show up for the searches that matter in your area. A good fit for businesses competing against multiple local rivals, or ones that have never had real local SEO work done.
benefits: Higher visibility in local search results and Google Maps
More enquiries from people already looking to buy
A clearer picture of which searches bring in customers
whatsIncluded: On-page optimisation for local search terms

process.title: Audit
process.description: We start by finding out where you currently rank, what's broken technically, and what your competitors are doing better.

process.title: Build
process.description: On-page fixes, content, and citations are put in place, prioritised by what will move the needle fastest.

process.title: Track
process.description: Rankings and traffic are monitored monthly, with the plan adjusted as your market and competitors change.

faqs.question: How long does Local SEO take to show results?
faqs.answer: SEO is a longer-term investment that builds over weeks and months rather than overnight — how quickly depends on how competitive your market is and what state your current site is in.

faqs.question: Do I need a new website for Local SEO to work?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily — we'll tell you honestly if your existing site is holding you back, but a lot of the work can be done regardless.

items.title: Google Business Profile Optimisation
items.summary: Turn your Google listing into your strongest source of new enquiries.
items.overview: We fully optimise your Google Business Profile — categories, service areas, photos, posts, and review management — so it works as hard as your website does. Best suited to businesses that already have a Google listing but have never had it properly set up.
benefits: Better visibility in the Google Maps 'local pack'
A profile that answers customer questions before they even call
More clicks, calls, and direction requests

process.title: Review
process.description: We check what's currently set up, what's missing, and what's actively working against you.

process.title: Optimise
process.description: Categories, services, descriptions, and photos are all brought up to a standard that converts.

process.title: Maintain
process.description: Ongoing posts, updates, and review responses keep the profile active — Google rewards profiles that stay current.

faqs.question: Can you manage my Google Business Profile if I already have one?
faqs.answer: Yes — most of our work is improving existing profiles rather than starting from scratch.

faqs.question: Do you respond to reviews for me?
faqs.answer: We can — either drafting responses for your approval or handling it directly, depending on what you'd prefer.

items.title: Website Design & Landing Page Build
items.summary: A site built to convert, not just to look good in a portfolio.
items.overview: A website that looks nice but doesn't generate enquiries isn't doing its job. We design sites around what a visitor needs to see to pick up the phone or fill in a form — built properly, not from a generic template.
benefits: A site built around your actual customers, not a stock template
Fast, mobile-first, and built to convert
Easy for you to update yourself, no developer needed
whatsIncluded: Custom design based on your business and market
Content management system so you can edit it yourself

process.title: Plan
process.description: We work out what the site needs to do for your business before any design starts.

process.title: Design & build
process.description: A site designed around your business, built properly rather than assembled from a generic template.

process.title: Launch & train
process.description: Once it's live, we show you how to update it yourself — no waiting on a developer for small changes.

faqs.question: Can I update the website myself once it's live?
faqs.answer: Yes — every site we build comes with a content management system so you can edit text, images, and pages without touching code.

faqs.question: How long does a new website take?
faqs.answer: It depends on scope and how quickly content is ready on your side — we'll give you a realistic estimate during the strategy call.

items.title: Social Media Management
items.summary: Consistent, on-brand posting across your channels with active replies, so your business stays visible between jobs.
items.overview: Your business shows up on social media even when you're not posting. We take that over — planning, creating, and publishing content that keeps your profiles active and on-brand, so social media stops being another thing on your to-do list.
benefits: Consistent posting
On-brand content
Better visibility
Monthly reporting
Time back for you

process.title: Discovery call
process.description: We learn your brand, audience, and goals.

process.title: Content plan
process.description: You approve a month of posts in advance.

process.title: Creation
process.description: We design, write and create every post for you.

process.title: Publishing
process.description: Posts go live on schedule, no input needed from you.

process.title: Reporting
process.description: Monthly check-in on performance and next steps.

faqs.question: How many posts do I get each month?
faqs.answer: That depends on your plan — we'll agree a posting frequency during onboarding and stick to it.

faqs.question: Do I need to approve posts before they go live?
faqs.answer: Yes, you'll get a content calendar to review each month before anything is published.

items.title: Missed-Call Text Back
items.summary: Automation that follows up missed calls for you when you can't get to the phone.
items.overview: Never lose a job to a missed call. The second a call goes unanswered, your customer gets an instant text back with a way to book, so the enquiry doesn't go to a competitor.
benefits: Fewer lost leads
Instant response
No extra effort
whatsIncluded: Custom message written for your business

process.title: Setup
process.description: We connect the service to your business number.

process.title: Customise
process.description: You approve the text message template.

process.title: Go live
process.description: Missed calls trigger an instant text automatically.

process.title: Review
process.description: Monthly reports show leads recovered.

faqs.question: What does the customer receive when I miss their call?
faqs.answer: An instant text letting them know you'll be in touch, with an option to leave details or book in directly.

faqs.question: Does this work with my existing business number?
faqs.answer: Yes, it connects to the number you already use, so there's nothing new for customers to learn.

items.title: Google Review Follow Up
items.summary: Automatic, on-brand follow-up that gets more of your happy customers leaving reviews.
items.overview: Most happy customers never leave a review, not because they don't want to, but because nobody asked them at the right time. We set up automatic, on-brand follow-up that asks at the right moment — without sounding like a robot.
benefits: More reviews from customers who were already happy
Follow-up that happens automatically, with no manual chasing
Requests and responses that sound like your business, not a template
whatsIncluded: On-brand messaging tailored to your business
Negative feedback routed privately before it becomes a public review
Monthly reporting on review volume and rating

process.title: Set up
process.description: Follow-up messaging is written in your voice and connected to however you currently manage customers.

process.title: Automate
process.description: Requests go out automatically at the right moment after a job or purchase — no manual chasing.

process.title: Monitor
process.description: Volume and sentiment are tracked monthly, with negative feedback flagged privately first.

faqs.question: Will this feel like spam to my customers?
faqs.answer: No — requests are timed and worded to feel like a genuine follow-up, not a mass blast.

faqs.question: What happens if a customer leaves negative feedback?
faqs.answer: It's routed to you privately first, so you can resolve it before it potentially becomes a public review.
